proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ G _ h
  have h1 := SimpleGraph.CliqueFree.card_edgeFinset_le (r := 2) h
  have h2 : Fintype.card V % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  dsimp only at h1
  generalize Fintype.card V = n at *
  have h3 : (n % 2).choose 2 = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt h2
  rw [h3, add_zero] at h1
  have h4 : (n ^ 2 - (n % 2) ^ 2) * (2 - 1) / (2 * 2) * 4 ≤ n ^ 2 := by
    have := Nat.div_mul_le_self ((n ^ 2 - (n % 2) ^ 2) * (2 - 1)) (2 * 2)
    simp only [Nat.reduceMul, Nat.reduceSub, mul_one] at this ⊢
    exact this.trans (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  omega
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → 4 * G.edgeFinset.card ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2
